notes.title: v1.0.8: Spell Perks
notes.content:
[h1]v1.0.8[/h1]
[h3][u]Features[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Perks[/u][/b]: Upgrade your skills with minor and major perks. Major perks significantly improve the behavior of each spell.
[*] [b][u]New Trap[/u][/b]: Exploding mushrooms? They're purple, they glow, and they explode!
[/list]
[u]Major Perks[/u]
[list]
[*] [i]The following is a quick rundown of the major perks for each skill. There are also two minor perks which slightly improve the core skill.[/i]
[*] Fireball: Explodes on impact for additional area damage.
[*] Self Heal: Instantly heals for 100% health.
[*] Blast Wave: Casts a second ring of fire outside of the first after the first expires.
[*] Short Teleport: Teleporting deals damage around the hero at the start and end locations.
[*] Electric Fire: Splits into three separate blasts.
[*] Heat Shield: Deals damage to nearby enemies while active.
[*] Molten Core: Can hit a second enemy, both impacts with area damage.
[*] Fire Wall: Casts a second wall perpendicular to the first.
[/list]
[u]Improvements[/u]
[list]
[*] Simple tutorial tooltip when the first perk becomes available.
[*] Can drag the perk to the skill bar to activate that spell.
[*] Reworked projectile casting to support perks.
[*] When opening windows, the most recently opened window will show up on top.
[*] Dragging a spell off the skill bar will remove it from the skill bar.
[*] Dragging spells between slots will swap their positions.
[*] Triggering a boss encounter and being locked out of the encounter area will now allow the encounter to reset.
[*] Minor visual fix to incorrect minimap visual in crypts.
[/list]
[h2]Developer's Note[/h2]

Spell perks are a major new feature. They vastly expand the various configurations available to load out your hero. You can set up your hero with different focuses, from an AOE damage focus, to a mobility focus, to a defensive focus, to a single target focus. Let me know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302666/76f9938a9f619e0d5ba381a0b1066931d9232ed4.jpg[/img]

Hope you enjoy the changes.

- Sarynth

notes.title: v1.0.7: Randomized Crypts
notes.content:
[h1]v1.0.7[/h1]
[h3][u]Features[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][u]New Dungeons[/u][/b]: Two new dungeon areas. Cemetery Crypt and Arachnid Tunnels. These areas are procedurally generated, so the layout and number of creatures will change with every visit.
[*] [b][u]New Creature[/u][/b]: Venom spitting spider.
[*] [b][u]New Spell[/u][/b]: Fire Wall unlocks at level 8, dealing intense damage over time to creatures standing in its wake. Melt your foes!
[*] Heavily rework checkpoint system.
[*] Game session is now preserved. Teleporting to scene two, then teleporting back to scene one will no longer cause all creatures to respawn. Exiting to the menu, or exiting the game will still cause creatures to show up again once loading or continuing the game.
[*] Game session is even more relevant as entering the crypt, then leaving the crypt will not suddenly respawn all of the creatures guarding the crypt entrance.
[/list]
[u]Improvements[/u]
[list]
[*] Minimap improvements. Two textures help show the areas off the main path where you can explore. Plus, third tile texture added for dungeon area.
[*] Move creature spawns further away from load game checkpoint locations.
[*] End of level light beams now grow brighter on mouse-over.
[*] New "invisible" checkpoints throughout the level, so if the player dies, they can respawn much closer to where they left off. Getting back to the fight more quickly.
[*] Additional checkpoint support for entering and leaving dungeon maps.
[/list]
[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fix minor error when clicking empty spell slots.
[*] Fix bug with game saved during credits scene could not be restarted.
[*] Fix bug with resume button not unpausing the game. (Pressing escape still worked.)
[*] Minor bug fixed issue with heal spell, fireball explosion particles colliding with invisible colliders/meshes.
[/list]
[u]Minor[/u]
[list]
[*] Pillar sizes reduced in introductory area, making it easier to see over.
[*] Added mouseover visual text to some scene change doors.
[*] Added minimap marker to dungeon teleport stone.
[*] Built out teleport interactable for warp stones and added to dungeons.
[/list]
[u]Internal Development[/u]
[i]Some developer improvements for those with curious minds.[/i]
[list]
[*] Add more validation that creatures are setup and configured correctly.
[*] Heavy customization of dungeon generation code to support future extensibility and reusability.
[*] Created internal dungeon generation automated testing.
[*] Improved experience tracking tool to support estimated experience from randomized dungeons.
[*] Solved issue with new outliner script. Now making it preferred over the old outline method. (Camera angle had to be rotated 0.01 degrees. Reported to asset author. Interactable objects currently support either outline method, or a custom object activation method.
[*] Built ConfirmationDialogWindow with reusable window prompt. Seen at the end of the dungeons.
[*] Quality of life editor tool: F1 now executes "Check and Play" safely entering play mode.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.5: Ratkin Nuisance
notes.content:
[h1]v1.0.5[/h1]
[u]2021-01-06[/u]
[list]
[*] New spell, heat shield. Protects the caster from incoming damage.
[*] Added a silhouette to creatures. Seeing skeletons behind rock walls is now easier.
[*] Adjust camera dolly to position player 5% higher in frame. Helps balance view range above and below.
[*] Clicking spells in the spell book or skill bar now casts the spell if a target is not required.
[*] Spell book window now shows the cooldown for spells. Adjusted sizing to show more spells.
[/list]
[u]Ratkin Valley[/u]
[list]
[*] New area has been released! Forge through the ratkin valley, eliminating the gloom crazed warriors.
[*] Includes new boss fight with the Ratkin Necromancer.
[*] Kill the two ratkin lieutenants and then liberate the main fortified camp.
[*] Ratkin horde introduced: Slave, Warrior, Rogue, Mercenary, Necromancer (+Marauder from caverns map.)
[/list]
[u]Spells[/u]
[list]
[*] Molten rock cooldown increased from 4s to 6s.
[*] Electric fire damage increased from 14-22 damage to 20-28 damage. Critical damage multiplier
   reduced from 1.5x to 1.4x. Cooldown improved from 0.5s to 0.4s.
[*] Fireball damage decreased from 20-35 damage to 20-32 damage.
[/list]
[u]Minor[/u]
[list]
[*] Support for multiple attack impacts from a single animation. (Creature combo attacks.)
[*] Fixed bug where spell would fire backwards when clicking very close to hero.
   With this fix, the skeleton boss needed a melee range attack for close combat.
[*] Fixed material on wizard hair and beard so it behaves better with particle effects.
[*] Fix bug where dying on mountain pass while torch was active would log an exception.
[*] Fixed bug with skill bar initialization when more than 7 skills.
[*] Refactored cooldown handling to support multiple visual representations of remaining time.
[*] Spell icons updated to better reflect their actions.
[*] Add more variation to melee creature impact sounds.
[*] Developed damage logic to support shield and buffs that may alter incoming damage.
[*] Fix bug where damage popup was not showing on orc boss damage spells.
[/list]
[u]Internal Development[/u]
[i]Some developer improvements for those with curious minds.[/i]
[list]
[*] Add global sound helper for common sound effects.
[*] Animancer clip state GUI now works with Odin foldout groups.
[*] Improved default values such as movement for hero debug window.
[*] Add rapid in-editor scene changer.
[*] Slider to adjust dolly zoom limits during playtesting.
[*] Minimap editor improvement, which increasesspeed and accuracy of positioning minimap areas.
[*] Adjust game data editor to include spell folders.
[*] Automated spell layer damage mask data integrity check. 
[*] Improved custom build player build pipeline to handle exceptions.
[/list]
